model_interpretation.claim: A scalar argmin has a loop-carried comparison and index dependency for every element. Tracking signed minima and their earliest indices per AVX-512 lane processes 16 values per vector while retaining the first-index tie rule. A scalar fallback handles short inputs and a scalar tail completes non-multiple-of-16 sizes; the target attribute requests AVX-512F locally for the supplied EPYC 9654 target.

items.subject: One-pass AVX-512 lane minima with earliest-index state
items.objective: Explore a one-pass AVX-512 lane-state argmin: keep each lane's signed minimum and earliest absolute index across successive 16-element vectors, then combine lane results using value-first and index-second ordering. Handle the initial block and scalar tail correctly, including INT32_MAX, INT32_MIN and ties. Stay within the supplied thread budget; compare correctness and repeated timings against the baseline.
